name: WTQ Pool
description: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接入 PI-Desktop。限流或额度用尽时自动换号，三家各有开关。
author: chengzhi-c (PI-Desktop port of XDTrees/dsh-workbuddy-xdpool)

en.name: WTQ Pool
en.description: Bring this machine's WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop sign-ins into PI-Desktop. An account that is rate-limited or out of credits fails over to the next one, and each source has its own switch.
en.safetyNotes: Reads the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder sign-ins already saved on this machine. It also reads the host's loaded provider and model names, never conversation content, to tell a same-named model from another provider apart. An account can also be signed in from the panel; that credential is stored only under the plugin's own data directory, and the panel can delete such an account again, removing the sign-in file and its archived copy together; a desktop snapshot of that account is no longer taken over, and signing in again with a new token brings it back. When an installation is not in its default location, only its uninstall registry entry is read to locate it. Keys for encrypted fields stay in memory. Tokens are sent only to each vendor's own hosts: copilot.tencent.com / www.codebuddy.cn / www.codebuddy.ai / www.workbuddy.ai, api.trae.cn / solo.trae.cn / trae-api-cn.mchost.guru / coresg-normal.trae.ai / growsg-normal.trae.ai, gateway.qoder.com.cn / openapi.qoder.com.cn / api3.qoder.sh / openapi.qoder.sh. Chat is served from an endpoint on 127.0.0.1; other local processes can call it and spend account quota.

zh-CN.name: WTQ Pool
zh-CN.description: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接入 PI-Desktop。限流或额度用尽时自动换号，三家各有开关。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只读本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 已保存的登录。同时读取宿主已加载的提供商与模型名称（不含会话内容），用于区分其他提供商的同名模型。也可以从面板登录账号，该凭证只写在插件自管数据目录内；面板可将这类账号连同登录文件与留档一并删除，桌面端遗留的同一份快照不再被接管，重新登录该账号（新令牌）即可回来。安装目录不在默认位置时，仅读取卸载项来定位。加密字段的密钥只保留在内存中。令牌只发往各家自己的接口：copilot.tencent.com / www.codebuddy.cn / www.codebuddy.ai / www.workbuddy.ai、api.trae.cn / solo.trae.cn / trae-api-cn.mchost.guru / coresg-normal.trae.ai / growsg-normal.trae.ai、gateway.qoder.com.cn / openapi.qoder.com.cn / api3.qoder.sh / openapi.qoder.sh。对话由本机 127.0.0.1 上的端点转发；同机其他进程也可调用并消耗账号额度。

changelog: 1.3.0：可从全局启动器或命令面板打开面板；修复升级后停用、移除、保底与偏好设置失效，关闭区域导致账号改名，模型列表失败重试无上限，手动刷新后的重试等待，以及与外部提供商同名模型的积分浮层误判；WAF 页面改按上游故障冷却；Windows 锁文件删除挂起时重试归档写入，删除期间的扫描不把账号写回归档，删除与续期同时发生时续期令牌不写回，无法读取的锁不按路径回收，删除记录读不到时不提交名单，不可排序的删除一并保留，删除失败重试回滚，删除后完成的续期不归档；轮流使用与固定账号时显示实际服务的账号；WorkBuddy 上游 5xx 自动换号。1.2.0 起提供商 ID 为 wtqpool-*，从 1.1.x 升级后需重新选择模型。
